statement.essentials: Most comparisons between operations come from records of what surgeons chose, so they cannot show that one operation is safer than another for the same tumour.
statement.anatomy: No randomised trial has compared extracapsular dissection with superficial parotidectomy. The studies are retrospective, differ in size, follow-up and tumour mix, and rarely say how the operation was chosen, which introduces selection bias.
statement.clinical: The UK national guideline asks only that benign parotid tumours be completely excised, which offers good cure rates.

limitations: Salzano 2025 is itself a single-arm pooled analysis of mostly retrospective studies with some internally inconsistent figures.
